# Set up environment

```{r}
#| label: setup-env
# Load in packages
if (!require("pacman")) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, here)

# Set working directory
here::i_am("scripts/L2/202_quantify_label_time.qmd")

# Point to directories
L0_data_dir <- here("data", "L0") # L0 data
L1_data_dir <- here("data", "L1") # L1 data
L2_data_dir <- here("data", "L2") # L2 data
```

```{r}
#| label: FX-fix-time
normalize_time <- function(time_str) {
  time_str <- str_to_lower(str_replace_all(time_str, "\\s+", ""))

  # Add colons if missing
  time_str <- case_when(
    str_detect(time_str, "^\\d{4}(am|pm)$") ~ str_replace(
      time_str,
      "(\\d{2})(\\d{2})",
      "\\1:\\2"
    ),
    str_detect(time_str, "^\\d{1,2}(am|pm)$") ~ str_replace(
      time_str,
      "(\\d+)",
      "\\1:00"
    ),
    TRUE ~ time_str
  )
  return(time_str)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: get-data
#read data
file_path <- "102_time_recording_labels.txt"
raw_lines <- readLines(here(L1_data_dir, file_path), warn = FALSE)


# Extract the manual QA/QC/Later hours
extra_hours <- 0
if (any(str_detect(raw_lines, "(?i)marked with.*look at later"))) {
  extra_hours <- extra_hours + 1.5
}
if (any(str_detect(raw_lines, "(?i)qa/qc data validation"))) {
  extra_hours <- extra_hours + 4.0
}

clean_lines <- raw_lines |>
  tail(-2) |>
  head(-2)


# Clean up dataframe
labeling_df <- clean_lines |>
  paste(collapse = "\n") |>
  read_delim(
    delim = "|",
    col_names = c("date", "time_range", "obs_range"),
    trim_ws = TRUE
  ) |>
  filter_out(is.na(date) | date == "") |>
  # Split start and end times
  separate(time_range, into = c("start_raw", "end_raw"), sep = "\\s*-\\s*") |>
  # Split start and end observation counts
  separate(obs_range, into = c("start_obs", "end_obs"), sep = "\\s*-\\s*") |>
  mutate(
    start_obs = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", start_obs)),
    end_obs = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", end_obs))
  ) |>
  # Clean up columns
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    start_time_str = normalize_time(start_raw),
    end_time_str = normalize_time(end_raw),

    # Parse into actual datetime objects
    start_dt = as.POSIXct(
      paste(date, start_time_str),
      format = "%Y-%m-%d %I:%M%p"
    ),
    end_dt = as.POSIXct(paste(date, end_time_str), format = "%Y-%m-%d %I:%M%p"),

    # Calculate time spent labelling in hours
    hours_spent = as.numeric(difftime(end_dt, start_dt, units = "hours")),

    # Clean up commas and text from numbers
    start_obs = as.numeric(str_remove_all(start_obs, "[,\\s]")),
    end_obs = as.numeric(str_remove_all(end_obs, "[,\\s|obs]")),
    obs_labeled = (end_obs - start_obs) + 1
  )
```


```{r}
#| label: summarize-stats
# Generate summary statistics
session_hours <- sum(labeling_df$hours_spent) # 75 hrs - Time spent label
total_hours <- session_hours + extra_hours # 80.5 hrs - Total time spent labelling
total_images <- sum(labeling_df$obs_labeled) # 78,529 Total images labelled
avg_speed <- total_images / session_hours # 1,047.053 Avg. images labelled per hour
avg_speed / 60 # 17.45089 avg. images labelled per minute

# Daily metrics
daily_breakdown <- labeling_df |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarize(
    `Hours Spent` = sum(hours_spent),
    `Images Labeled` = sum(obs_labeled),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(as.data.frame(daily_breakdown))
```
